evidence_class: new development intervention on previously inspected SCORPION; NOT independent confirmation, cannot convert RT3/RT1 failures into passes
hypothesis: a train-only scanner-matched region-identity contrastive anchor can prevent isotropic/tangent invariance objectives from crowding distinct tissue regions, and may improve tangent regularization without increased scanner leakage

dataset.name: SCORPION
dataset.preprocessing: exact RT1 AT2 train slide-only PCA
dataset.heldout_operator_calibration: val only, calibrated transfer NOT zero-shot

training.base_training: RT3 train_arm exactly for arms without identity; RT3 matched initialization and 160 epochs, AdamW LR1e-3 WD1e-4 for new arms
training.identity_positive: correct paired same region across AT2 and each known nonreference scanner; scanner input inverse is stop_gradient(T_s^-1(x_s))
training.sham_positive: fixed slide-deranged one-to-one train-region mapping, every positive on a different train slide
training.sampling: 8 train-only AT2 candidate regions per training query, four from designated positive's slide and four from other training slides, excluding designated positive
training.hyperparam_search: none, one fixed mechanistic contrast; no selection on consumed test slides

evaluation.unit: source slide (48) independent only if slide independence is valid; no patient identity inference
evaluation.seed_mean: average within slide x heldout scanner across 3 seeds
evaluation.scanner_mean: average 4 scanner holdout contrasts within slide
evaluation.primary_retrieval: same-region cosine top1 against entire heldout test fold AT2 reference gallery

mechanism_gate.confidence: both lower 95% source-slide bootstrap bounds > 0, descriptive development only
guardrails: candidate minus inverse_residual_tangent reference reconstruction upper95CI <= +0.03 MSE
candidate minus inverse_residual_tangent known-scanner ridge probe accuracy upper95CI <= +0.02
candidate minus inverse_residual_tangent within-slide retrieval lower95CI >= -0.02
candidate heldout and known direct transport gains lower95CI > 0
all arms exactly 9640 model parameters and initialized identically within model seed
mechanism_gate.status_if_all_pass: mechanism_development_supported_only; NOT biological sufficient or independently confirmed
mechanism_gate.independent_biology_gate: unavailable from current evidence, explicitly OPEN, cannot claim full PA-NF scientific superiority

interpretation.real_beats_sham_and_target: correct paired-region supervision contributes to retrieval; not evidence of clinical biology retention
interpretation.real_beats_target_not_sham: generic auxiliary training or accidental regularization may explain gain
interpretation.no_gain: identity anchor does not repair crowding as implemented

claim_boundary: RT4 tests a single fixed mechanism on burned development data; even a pass does not rescue prior frozen failures or support independent clinical biological sufficiency.
